properties.name: phoneNumberId
properties.description: The phone number ID taken from whatsapp-business dashboard.

properties.name: lazyStartProducer
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

properties.name: baseUri
properties.label: advanced
properties.description: Can be used to set an alternative base URI, e.g. when you want to test the component against a mock WhatsApp API

properties.name: authorizationToken
properties.label: security
properties.description: The authorization access token taken from whatsapp-business dashboard.

properties.name: webhookSecret
properties.label: security
properties.description: The app secret used to verify the X-Hub-Signature-256 signature of inbound webhook event payloads (from the Meta/WhatsApp app dashboard). When set, event callbacks with a missing or invalid signature are rejected with HTTP 403; when not set, no signature verification is performed.
